section.title: Purpose
section.para: Publishes the high-level description of the forward fuselage section derived from the section SSOT and the radome leaf SSOT.
The section contains the nose, flight deck, forward pressure bulkhead, NLG bay, forward equipment bay, forward barrel, and forward door/hatch surrounds.

section.title: Structural decomposition
section.para: The section-level SSOT defines eight child structural branches: nose structure and radome backup; forward pressure bulkhead; flight deck structure; side-window structural surrounds; nose landing gear bay and attach; forward equipment bay structure; forward barrel skin/stringer/frame; and forward door/hatch surrounds.
System ownership remains outside this element for lightning protection, avionics/weather radar, cooling, and landing-gear systems; this data module therefore publishes structure and provisions only.

section.title: Detailed source projection available at baseline
section.para: The only detailed leaf source attached at baseline is the radome (`eWTW-PBS-10-10-10-10-10`). It is the RF-transparent nose fairing, forward of the forward pressure bulkhead, and is driven by RF transparency, bird strike, lightning Zone 1A, rain erosion, and moisture-ingress control.
The radome owns the fairing, attachment, sealing, and bonding provisions; weather-radar and lightning-diverter system content is referenced by `dmRef`, never duplicated.
